question: Where is Dhul-Kifl mentioned in the Quran?
answer: Dhul-Kifl is mentioned in 2 ayahs of the Quran.
name: Dhul-Kifl

evidence.ar: وَإِسۡمَٰعِيلَ وَإِدۡرِيسَ وَذَا ٱلۡكِفۡلِۖ كُلّٞ مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
evidence.en: And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient.
evidence.de: Und (auch) Isma’il und Idris und Du’l-Kifl. Jeder gehörte zu den Standhaften.

evidence.ar: وَٱذۡكُرۡ إِسۡمَٰعِيلَ وَٱلۡيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلۡكِفۡلِۖ وَكُلّٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَخۡيَارِ
evidence.en: And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhul-Kifl, and all are among the outstanding.
evidence.de: Und gedenke Isma’ils, Alyasa’s und Du ’-Kifls. Alle gehören zu den Besten.
